title: Jacob Rodri on X: "I never imagined creating duolingo-level animations with AI would be possible in 2026 1. Generate an AI video with Seedance 2.5 2. Vectorize it frame by frame 3. Export it as an animated SVG ready to use in your app This guy is cooking" / X
description:
I never imagined creating duolingo-level animations with AI would be possible in 2026

1. Generate an AI video with Seedance 2.5
2. Vectorize it frame by frame
3. Export it as an animated SVG ready to use in your app

This guy is cooking
